mapper.select: SELECT t1.corp_gr AS corpGr , t1.enc_acct_no AS encAcctNo , t1.fund_cd AS fundCd , t1.fund_nm AS fundNm , t1.type_gb AS typeGb , TO_CHAR(t1.fst_seolj_ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS fstSeoljYmd , t1.sintak_gigan AS sintakGigan , TO_CHAR(t1.bf_gyul_ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS bfGyulYmd , TO_CHAR(t1.af_gyul_ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS afGyulYmd , t1.target_jasan AS targetJasan , t1.gyul_gi AS gyulGi , t1.haeji_gb AS haejiGb , TO_CHAR(t1.haeji_ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS haejiYmd , t1.re_seolj_year AS reSeoljYear , t1.re_seolj_aek AS reSeoljAek , t1.mg_cd AS mgCd , TO_CHAR(t1.re_seolj_ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reSeoljYmd , t1.series_gb AS seriesGb , TO_DECRYPTS(t1.enc_acct_no) AS acctNo , se.gugan AS gugan FROM SZM0IA t1 , SZX0SE se WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, TO_DATE('2099-12-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) > TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND se.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND se.series_gb = t1.series_gb ORDER BY t1.haeji_gb ASC, t1.mg_cd ASC, t1.fund_nm ASC, t1.re_seolj_ymd ASC

SELECT TO_CHAR(gu.m3_fymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS m3Fymd , TO_CHAR(gu.m3_tymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS m3Tymd , TO_CHAR(gu.g3b_fymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS g3bFymd , TO_CHAR(gu.g3b_tymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS g3bTymd , TO_CHAR(gu.b3_fymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS b3Fymd , TO_CHAR(gu.b3_tymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS b3Tymd , '평균비율구간 : ' || TO_CHAR(gu.m3_fymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || ' - ' || TO_CHAR(gu.m3_tymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') AS g1Text , '평균비율구간 : ' || TO_CHAR(gu.g3b_fymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || ' - ' || TO_CHAR(gu.g3b_tymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') AS g2Text , '평균비율구간 : ' || TO_CHAR(gu.b3_fymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || ' - ' || TO_CHAR(gu.b3_tymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') AS g3Text , gu.m3_gu AS m3Gu , gu.g3_gu AS g3Gu FROM TABLE(F_GUGAN(#{corpGr}, #{fundCd}, TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'))) gu
